title: Remove Native Algorithm Adapters
description: Remove all native adapters from compose/algorithms. The new architecture uses compose/rs as the single source of truth and re-exports it through compose/js, compose/react, and compose/ui. Refactor existing files and tests without legacy support.
summary: Removed the remaining native-adapter surface from compose/algorithms by deleting the ignored native bridge sources and language decorator file from the workspace, keeping Storybook on the rs-backed @compose/js/@compose/react/@compose/ui path. Fixed algorithms Storybook imports to use @storybook/react-vite, adjusted the embedded public-surface guard to use import.meta.vitest, and added tsconfig aliases/types needed by the rs WASM re-export path. Verification: npx tsc --noEmit -p compose/algorithms/tsconfig.json passed; npm --workspace @compose/algorithms run lint passed; npm --workspace @compose/algorithms run test passed with the package's no-test-files configuration; npm --workspace @compose/algorithms run build completed successfully with existing Vite/docgen warnings.
